items.headline: Deployable Energy picks Sargent & Lundy for Unity-1 licensing work
items.what_happened: On 2026-10-14 Deployable Energy said it selected Sargent & Lundy to provide engineering and licensing support for Unity-1, a 1-MWe nuclear battery. The work supports the company's planned NRC construction permit application, which Deployable Energy is targeting for submittal without a stated date. The NRC pre-application page lists a readiness assessment request for that application.
items.why_it_matters: For a 1-20 MW buyer this is licensing progress on a 1 MWe unit, not a power sale. The release gives no contract value and no permit filing date.
items.binding_note: The release says Deployable Energy selected Sargent & Lundy. It names no contract value, and the signed engagement itself was not retrieved.
